items.html: No deferred async mechanics — the ACTION_RESULT event contract serves inline AND deferred, but the genuinely-async driver (long-running runs, in-flight tracking) + a timeout on a pending auto action are later → L9

No unbounded retry / watchdog — retry is a declared bounded budget that escalates; auto-retry beyond it, backoff, and a stuck-action_running watchdog are later (the same crash-window class as LC2 / LC3a) → L9
No pure computed-routing — routing on a verdict + counter with no runner / side effect / ACTION_RESULT (v1's auto_rework) is a routing-policy concern, not a workflow action → later
No rich outcome-predicate DSL — classify_action_result stays exit-code / structured-JSON (L2a-style) → later
No packaged action library — pairflow.perf_test is the anchor; publish / notify / a general catalog are examples, not built → later

No undeclared-outcome recovery — a classified outcome with no declared route records an unhandled ACTION_RESULT and stays action_running (a config gap, no operator to nudge); reconciling it is later → L9
